_metadata.description: In-browser Monaco editor wired to the API for safe TSX content I/O.

requirements.title: Monaco editor loads a component's TSX content from the API and saves edits back
requirements.description: The UI editor page mounts Monaco configured for TypeScript/JSX. On open, it fetches `GET /api/v1/components/{id}/content`. On save, it PUTs to the same endpoint. Format-on-type is enabled via Monaco defaults; the project does not bundle a TypeScript compiler.

validation.notes: UI component test renders the Editor page against a mock client, asserts content roundtrips through the API stub.

requirements.title: Content I/O is routed through `package:api-core/storage` with path-traversal rejection
requirements.description: API content endpoints resolve filesystem paths only via `storage.NewResolver` rooted at the configured components root. Any resolved path that escapes the root is rejected with HTTP 400 and a structured error code `path_outside_root`.

validation.notes: Handler test feeds malicious component IDs (`..`, absolute paths, symlinks) and asserts 400 with the expected error code.
